background: Erste Group is an Austrian bank with the leading retail franchise across Central and Eastern Europe, funded by local deposits in Austria, the Czech Republic, Slovakia, Romania, Hungary and Croatia, and part-owned by its founding savings-bank foundation.
synthesis: Moody's upgraded the bank to Aa3 on 21 Apr 2026 and still has it on a positive outlook, as does S&P at A+, with Fitch at A stable. Capital reads mixed against EU and Nordic banks: CET1 of 14.4% is below the median while leverage of 6.4% is above it, the pattern of a bank carrying heavier risk weights than its Western European peers. Funding is the strong point, with NSFR of 137% in the top quarter and LCR of 149% only just below the median. The drift on figures to 30 Jun 2026 is mildly negative, with CET1 down 1.1 points and leverage down 0.8 points since 30 Jun 2024 and NSFR down 7 points since 30 Jun 2025, and nothing has been flagged in the last 90 days.
